messages:
Lina: hey team :wave: i'm Lina (started today) — quick first-week Qs about ownership so i know who to ping. 1) who owns request routing / model fallback policy (e.g., when Dedicated capacity is constrained)? 2) who do i request Dedicated console access from / what's the approver flow? 3) if inference latency or errors spike in prod who gets paged vs who owns postmortems? also would love the access-request template/link. thanks!

Alex: welcome, Lina! routing & fallback policy is owned by eng-platform. ping @eng-platform in Slack or open a routing-policy ticket. For live incidents page eng-sre oncall first — they triage and escalate to eng-platform / eng-runtime / eng-ml depending on cause. :+1:

Marina: hi Lina — for Dedicated console access open an IT ticket with subject: `Access Request: Dedicated Console - <your-email>`. Include your manager as approver and mention required org role (dev / infra / qa). We use Okta group `redwood-dedicated-users` so you'll be added once approved. If you need quota increase, add the expected QPS and project name.

Devon: quick note on escalation paths: page -> ack -> determine service owner. If it's infra-level (GPUs, capacity) -> eng-platform. If runtime errors (KV cache, batching) -> eng-runtime. If model quality regressions -> eng-ml. For any customer-facing outage, tag `customer-impact` and loop in customer-success.

Samira: linking internal docs: /docs/org/ownership (org chart + owners) and /onboarding/access-requests (templates + where to file). Escalation cheat-sheet: `oncall (eng-sre)` -> `eng-platform` -> `eng-runtime` -> `eng-ml`; always CC `security@redwood.com` for anything that looks like data exposure.

Deploy-bot: Deploy notice — rollback policy v2 applied to main canary at 11:10 UTC.

Emily: for billing or quota-cost questions ping finance (channel: #finance) or email `billing@redwood.com`. I can help surface requests if you flag me.

Lina: awesome, thanks everyone. @Marina can you drop the access request template here so i can copy?

Marina: pasted template below:
```
Subject: Access Request: Dedicated Console - lina@example.com
Requester: Lina (lina@example.com)
Manager: <manager-name>
Role: Developer
Environment: dev/stage/prod
Reason: Onboarding / need to test model routing and monitor Dedicated pool for feature X
Approver: <manager-email>
Requested Okta group: redwood-dedicated-users
Additional notes: expected QPS: 50, project: example-app
```

Lina: filed the ticket and added my manager, thanks all :sparkles: feel free to DM if i missed anything.
